name: Detection Evasion
description: Ability to evade defensive controls during red team operations including EDR, AV, network monitoring, SIEM, and SOC analysts. Covers payload obfuscation, in-memory execution, living-off-the-land techniques, log evasion, traffic blending, and anti-forensics within rules of engagement. Operational application across an engagement; Windows security-subsystem internals belong to SWSEC-OS-WINEVADE.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to detection evasion concepts

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands common detection mechanisms and the concept of evasion
evidence: Completed training on defensive detection technologies (AV, EDR, SIEM)
Can explain the detection pipeline from telemetry to alert
Understands why evasion is necessary for realistic adversarial simulation

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Applies basic evasion techniques under supervision
evidence: Used living-off-the-land binaries (LOLBins) in lab exercises
Applied basic payload obfuscation techniques with guidance
Understands signature-based vs behavioural detection and their implications

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently evades standard defensive controls during engagements
evidence: Successfully operated undetected against EDR solutions in 3+ engagements
Performs pre-engagement payload testing against target's defensive stack
Adapts techniques in response to detection during live operations
Documents evasion techniques used for debrief and reporting

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Evades mature SOC teams and advanced defensive stacks; develops custom evasion tooling
evidence: Evaded detection by active SOC with advanced EDR during multi-week operations
Developed custom loaders, packers, or obfuscation tooling for the lab
Analysed specific EDR internals to identify blind spots
Mentors team on evasion methodology and operational tradecraft

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Researches novel evasion techniques; defines lab evasion methodology; presents at conferences
evidence: Published research on novel evasion techniques or defensive bypass methods
Discovered new EDR blind spots or bypass techniques
Defines the lab's evasion tooling standards and testing methodology
Trains teams and presents at industry conferences on evasion tradecraft

assessment_methods.description: Execute a simulated attack chain against a defended lab environment with EDR and monitoring; assessed on stealth and objective completion
Given a specific defensive stack description, propose an evasion strategy and justify technique selection
